CustomField.description: Evaluates to true if the current date falls between Start Date and End Date.
CustomField.formula: AND( NOT(ISNULL(Start_Date__c)), NOT(ISNULL(End_Date__c)), TODAY() >= Start_Date__c, TODAY() <= End_Date__c )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Evaluates to true if the current date falls between Start Date and End Date.
CustomField.label: Active
